---
title: "`r params$ticker` Price Report"
output: html_document
params:
  ticker: "TICKER"
  ticker_data: NULL
  reference_name: "Sector"
  n_reference_stocks: 0
  valuation_data: NULL
  valuation_metric_name: "EV to NOPAT (per share)"
  valuation_n_stocks: 0
  anomaly_data: NULL
  sector_name: "Sector"
  industry_name: "Industry"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
set_ggplot_theme()
```

## Cumulative Return

```{r return-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_cumulative_return(
  params$ticker_data,
  params$ticker,
  reference_name = params$reference_name,
  n_reference_stocks = params$n_reference_stocks
)
```

## Drawdown from Highs

```{r drawdown-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_drawdown(params$ticker_data, params$ticker) %>%
  add_data_callout(label_fn = scales::percent)
```

## Valuation

```{r valuation-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_valuation_ratio(
  params$valuation_data,
  params$ticker,
  metric_name = params$valuation_metric_name,
  reference_name = params$reference_name,
  n_reference_stocks = params$valuation_n_stocks
)
```

## Valuation Anomaly Detection

```{r anomaly-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# Fit elliptic envelope
envelope <- fit_elliptic_envelope(
  params$anomaly_data$ev_nopat_yoy_change,
  params$anomaly_data$ev_nopat,
  contamination = 0.1
)

# Create plot
plot_elliptic_envelope(
  data = params$anomaly_data,
  x_col = "ev_nopat_yoy_change",
  y_col = "ev_nopat",
  ticker_col = "ticker",
  group_col = "industry",
  target_ticker = params$ticker,
  target_group = params$industry_name,
  envelope_fit = envelope,
  x_label = "YoY Change in EV/NOPAT",
  y_label = "EV to NOPAT (per share)",
  subtitle = paste0(
    "n = ", nrow(params$anomaly_data), " stocks in ", params$sector_name,
    " sector; EV/NOPAT clipped at 100x"
  )
)
```
